posts.text: 🤖 AI Platform Hidden code in Claude Code secretly flagged Chinese users The Decoder · 🟧 Claude · 1h ago • Anthropic is removing hidden monitoring code in Claude Code that flagged Chinese users after social media backlash. • The undisclosed feature raises transparency concerns about how AI tools monitor users based on geography. • The removal signals Anthropic is addressing user privacy and trust issues in its developer products. 🤖 AI Platform Claude Sonnet 5 continues Anthropic's pattern of hiding price increases behind unchanged token rates The Decoder · 🟧 Claude · 1h ago • Claude Sonnet 5 consumes 40% more tokens per task than its predecessor, nearly doubling effective costs. • Token rates remain unchanged while actual expenses rise, obscuring true price increases from users. • Sonnet 5 ranks fifth in Artificial Analysis benchmarks, outperforming the pricier Opus 4.8 on some agent tasks. 🤖 AI Platform Claude Helped a Hacker Find a Way to Issue Tickets to Almost Every US Music Festival Wired – AI · 🟧 Claude · 2h ago • A researcher used Claude Opus 4.7 to break into Front Gate ticketing and issue unauthorized festival tickets. • The vulnerability affected ticketing for major US festivals including Lollapalooza and Bonnaroo. • The exploit highlights security risks when AI systems assist in finding web application vulnerabilities. Read more →

🤖 AI Platform Anthropic's Fable 5 is back worldwide after a two-week government ban over a jailbreak The Decoder · 🟧 Claude · 4h ago • Anthropic's Fable 5 returned globally after a two-week US government ban over a jailbreak vulnerability. • Amazon researchers discovered the exploit, but Anthropic said smaller models like Claude Haiku 4.5 could replicate it. • Anthropic deployed a new safety classifier to block the jailbreak technique across models. 🤖 AI Platform OpenAI paper reveals three GPT-5.6 Pro models, breaking with single top-tier strategy The Decoder · 🟢 ChatGPT · 2h ago • OpenAI's benchmark paper hints at three GPT-5.6 Pro model variants, marking ChatGPT Pro's first major structural change. • Multiple Pro tiers would depart from OpenAI's current single top-tier strategy. • The shift suggests OpenAI is segmenting its premium offering across different use cases or performance levels.
